regeneration.desc: Gain +2 Regeneration at level 1 and an additional +1 at 5, 10, 15, and 20

brawler.desc: Gain +1 to hit at level 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20

thug.desc: Gain +1 to damage at level 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20

hearty.desc: Gain +6 Hit Points at level 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20

nimble.desc: Gain +1 Armor Class at level 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20

thickskinned.desc: Gain +2 DR at level 1, and +1 additional at 5, 10, 15, and 20

opportunist.desc: Gain +2 to initiative at level 1, and +1 additional at 5, 10, 15, and 20

nebulous.desc: Gain +6% to blur at level 1, and +1% additional at 5, 10, 15, and 20

cursed.desc: Take a -5 penalty on hit, damage, and armor class at level 1, and an additional -3 at 5, 10, 15, and 20 Be warned, being cursed also means you take a [color=red][b]90%[/b][/color] penalty in all xp/renown earned.
